claims.original_statement: The kernel of K_0(C)->K_0(A) consists of the differences [H^0]-[H^1] of the specified periodic complexes exact in A/C.
claims.proved_statement: For prescribed objects P,Q of a small abelian category A, [P]=[Q] in K_0(A) if and only if there is a periodic complex on one object M whose H^0 is isomorphic to P and whose H^1 is isomorphic to Q. If P,Q lie in a Serre subcategory C, the constructed complex is exact in A/C.
claims.exact_transport: Use the labelled permutation J:M^+->M^- and the source maps phi:M^+->M^-, psi:M^-->M^+. On M=M^+ set phi_hat=psi J and psi_hat=J^{-1} phi. All summands, zero components and signs are retained.
claims.receiving_proof: chow.tex at pinned commit, lines 18526-18568, especially 18548-18553
claims.propagation: The receiving proof needs realization of its prescribed pair, not only equality of differences of classes. The exact construction supplies it; no receiving statement is invalidated or body edit forced.
claims.other_reference_uses: Chow lines 3792 and 13180 use part (1), unchanged. Line 18414 gives motivation. The reference at 18546 uses part (1).
claims.limits: This verifies the use of the Homology result, not every geometric dependency of the Chow proof.
claims.next: Carry this proved strengthening and exact witness into the separate editorial supplement and claim ledger at Homology integration.
